==Usage instructions==
<pre><nowiki>{{IBI|filename|caption}}</nowiki></pre>

===Notes===
This is the "image beside infobox" template. It allows thumbs to sit alongside long infoboxes on detail-heavy articles, particularly starships.

==Example==
====Code====
<code><nowiki>{{IBI|File:BLOC01AB.jpg|This is a picture beside an infobox.}}</nowiki></code>
